Headline: #3 King Drive Temporary Reroute near King Drive/76th
ShortDescription: #3 King Drive buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near King Drive/76th.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#3 King Drive buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near King Drive/76th.

Southbound buses will operate via King Drive, 76th, Lafayette, 79th, and King Drive then over their normal route.

Northbound buses will operate via King Drive, 79th, State, 76th, and King Drive then over their normal route

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Green Line Experiencing Delays; Boarding change between 35th and King Dr./Halsted
ShortDescription: Green Line service running w/delays due to track conditions near Garfield; board all trains on the Harlem-bound side between 35th and King Dr./Halsted.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Green Line service running w/major delays due to track conditions near Garfield.

Trains, in both directions, are running on the same track between 35th and King Drive / Halsted stations.

Board/exit all trains on the Harlem-bound side of the platform at:

  • Indiana, 43rd, 47th, 51st and Garfield stations.

We're working to restore normal service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
